design_statement: Build the Japan-wide species-level nuclear scaffold first; map capitulum-trait histories second; add population RAD only inside focal lineages and transition neighbourhoods; keep M01 as an embedded mechanistic depth case.

taxonomic_census.freeze_rule: Before destructive field collection, reconcile the current NMNS authority records into an operational accepted species-concept list; retain varieties, unpublished/new-name records, synonyms and taxonomic conflicts as explicit statuses rather than counting every database row as a species.
taxonomic_census.budget_reopen_rule: If the frozen operational census exceeds 125 primary species concepts, reopen the nationwide individual budget before collection rather than silently reducing per-species replication.

nationwide_sampling.base_rule: Every admitted species concept receives two independent biological individuals where conservation and access permit.
nationwide_sampling.geographic_rule: The two base individuals should come from different populations or clearly separated geographic occurrences where feasible; two adjacent ramets from one patch are not a substitute for geographic replication.
nationwide_sampling.rare_taxon_exception: A single authorized individual may represent a very rare or legally constrained species, but it remains SINGLE_SAMPLE_LIMITED and cannot be replaced by a convenience relative.

triggers: multiple cytotypes or genome-size classes suspected
replicate non-monophyly or strong gene-tree discordance in the first wave
taxonomic complex requiring multiple geographic representatives
high leverage for P01-P05 or M01 transition placement

nationwide_sampling.interpretation: 290-300 is a planning envelope for a nationwide bank, not a requirement to force exactly 120-125 species after taxonomic reconciliation.

target_capture.assay: Comp1061-compatible nuclear target capture or an explicitly crosswalked equivalent

wave_1.rule: Sequence the two base individuals for every admitted species concept first.

wave_2.rule: Sequence up to 50 preregistered enrichment individuals only for taxa assigned to T2/T3 before inspecting focal trait-history outcomes.

species_tree_rules: retain individual-level sequences through QC and gene-tree inference rather than collapsing field individuals before checking concordance
infer a coalescent-aware species-tree ensemble and retain gene-tree discordance
run reticulation/network sensitivity for lineages showing replicate non-monophyly or cytonuclear/genome-wide conflict
do not assume species monophyly merely because a taxonomic name is shared
do not concatenate plastid and nuclear histories into one organismal tree
target_capture.mixed_ploidy_rule: Use target capture as the primary cross-ploidy scaffold; retain phased/homeolog-aware sensitivity where feasible and do not let mixed-ploidy RAD calling define the nationwide species tree.

same_individual_measurements.purpose: The national tree is simultaneously the individual-linked phenotype scaffold for P01-P05; species-tree sampling must not recreate species-tip compression by omitting the phenotype of the sequenced individual.

population_rad.nesting_rule: For each focal species, choose up to four nationwide target-capture representatives from the same population-RAD individuals; do not collect separate tree-only plants when the same verified individual can serve both roles.
population_rad.rad_extension_rule: After the nationwide species-tree ensemble and trait histories are frozen, add RAD to further transition neighbourhoods only where population ancestry or introgression can distinguish competing histories.

m01.rna_rule: Within Okinawa Honto, Amami Oshima, Miyako and Ishigaki discovery populations, collect six developmentally matched floral samples per population, sequence five primary RNA replicates and retain one reserve.
m01.expansion_rule: Additional M01 islands/populations remain conditional on E1/E2 promotion and are not required to complete the nationwide species tree.
